lede: South Carolina carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.1 against +4.1, a 2.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Alabama -12.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 80% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where South Carolina leads Alabama by 76 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 86% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
